description: Full signal over its leading squeezed term against k3/k12 (k1 = k2). abs and arg of the complex ratio. charged_scalar: sum line of the bispectrum of Sec. 7.5 (BBSX model). higgs_portal: leading family of the loop of Sec. 6.3 (Delta = 3 + 2 i mu for a heavy Higgs, 3 - 2 nu for a light one). 'tables' holds the complete bispectra of the two scripts. dirac_bubble and top_quark: truncated series of the pair signal.

dirac_bubble.note: Pair signal only, hard vertex with time derivatives (r1 = 4), series through n = 8; last_term is the relative size of the last term kept.

top_quark.note: kappa = 0, series through n = 7 (odd orders only), relative to its first term n = 1.

wz.note: No full shape. Orders 0 and 1 of the hard vertex: see CHECKS.md, C1 and C2.
